standards: Every idea through the alpha gate

page.title: Research Record
page.purpose: Every strategy we backtested, how we tested it, and why only one book survived. The live tabs show what runs; this page shows the evidence behind it, including everything that failed.
page.footer: Research code is private; methods summarised below.

headline.label: Deployed Trend+Carry book (v44 = v42 FINAL)
headline.note: Earlier vintages (v33 base book 1.03, v39 stack 1.25 at native vol) appear only inside their own study panels, each with its data vintage. Numbers differ across vintages because the price cache was re-downloaded between studies.

studies.title: Era 1: the S&P "TGA" engine (v10–v25)
studies.hypothesis: Graph-topology and reversal signals on S&P 500 single names earn a daily edge.

studies.title: Multi-sleeve re-measure
studies.hypothesis: Adding pairs and PEAD sleeves to the S&P engine lifts the combined book.

studies.title: Slow-book rebuild
studies.hypothesis: Vol-targeted momentum plus PEAD and a capped reversion leg make a viable S&P book.

studies.title: Clean-data sleeves and the PEAD beta test
studies.hypothesis: At least one S&P single-name sleeve has standalone alpha after costs.

studies.title: Cross-asset time-series momentum
studies.hypothesis: Trend across ~23 liquid ETFs earns a positive, crisis-positive premium.

studies.title: Carry / defensive sleeve and the blend
studies.hypothesis: A carry/defensive sleeve, risk-parity blended with trend, beats either alone.

studies.title: Wiring Trend+Carry into paper trading
studies.hypothesis: The book can be paper-traded daily from a single source of truth.

studies.title: Pairs as a third sleeve
studies.hypothesis: Cointegrated S&P pairs add an uncorrelated third sleeve to the book.

studies.title: Flagship validation
studies.hypothesis: The base Trend+Carry book survives Monte Carlo, sensitivity and crisis tests.

studies.title: How the book works (leverage explainer)
studies.hypothesis: The book's Sharpe is invariant to the vol target; CAGR is a leverage dial.

studies.title: Alpha gate, FX and meta-labeling
studies.hypothesis: An FX sleeve diversifies the book, and a meta-label model improves trend entries.

studies.title: LSTM features for the meta model
studies.hypothesis: LSTM-learned features or a vol forecaster lift the meta model.

studies.title: LSTM, leak-free walk-forward
studies.hypothesis: The v36 LSTM lift survives when the LSTM is trained walk-forward.
studies.row_note: best leak-free variant; champion without LSTM 1.226

studies.title: Diversifiers and the regime de-risk overlay
studies.hypothesis: A new uncorrelated sleeve or a risk overlay improves the book.

studies.title: Capstone validation and deployment
studies.hypothesis: The full stack (base → meta → regime → 8% vol) passes every gate together.

studies.title: Claude News Overlay (design)
studies.hypothesis: A pinned LLM reading point-in-time news can improve the regime de-risk.

studies.title: Auditing our own live P&L
studies.hypothesis: The live paper-trading P&L measures the strategies, not the plumbing.

studies.title: Trend-signal refinements (Baltas–Kosowski)
studies.hypothesis: A t-statistic trend signal, range-based vol or a correlation factor improves the trend sleeve.

studies.title: Replicating a published 49%-a-year stat-arb
studies.hypothesis: Graph-clustered intra-cluster reversal (SPONGE + classifier) earns the published return.
studies.row_note: paper-faithful R1 shown; the realistic R4 never traded

studies.title: Promotion of A1 + paper-track rebuild
studies.hypothesis: The v42 TREND signal can go live without changing anything else in the book.
